scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @easydraw/shared-types && npm run build -w @easydraw/diagram-schema && npm run build -w @easydraw/diagram-import && npm run build -w @easydraw/objects-3d && npm run build -w @easydraw/pack-whiteboard
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck -w @easydraw/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @easydraw/diagram-schema && npm run typecheck -w @easydraw/diagram-import && npm run typecheck -w @easydraw/objects-3d && npm run typecheck -w @easydraw/pack-whiteboard
scripts.test:packages: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @easydraw/diagram-schema && npm run test -w @easydraw/diagram-import && npm run test -w @easydraw/objects-3d && npm run test -w @easydraw/pack-whiteboard
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test -w easydraw
scripts.test:diagram3d: node --test scripts/test-diagram3d.mjs scripts/test-diagram3d-editing.mjs scripts/test-graph-actions.mjs scripts/test-save-queue.mjs scripts/test-ungroup-graph.mjs
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w easydraw
scripts.build:client: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w easydraw
scripts.test:client: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w easydraw
